name: A manager-mediated house does not expose a resident self-service queue

statusDetails.message: GET /api/houses showed A route manager, B self-service; POST /api/queue for A returned 403 "Contact manager; this house does not offer a resident queue." The same request for B returned 200 and a waiting entry. Both houses were configured and households registered on fresh state.

labels.name: story
labels.value: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles

steps.name: Given A routes to manager and B allows resident self-service queue
When residents inspect their house routes and request queue entry
Then A directs to manager without a resident queue and B accepts its configured queue route
